title: Biological Computing Co. Launches AI Video Tool Built From Brain Cell Research
summary:
A new commercial AI video generator called Mischief 1 now allows users to create image-to-video clips for as little as 0.5 cents per second. The product, developed by the Biological Computing Co., is currently available through OpenRouter and fal and will be added to the AWS Marketplace. The company says the tool is at least 5x faster than its base model.

The model was developed from a four year study in which the company grew living neurons on electrodes to map how brain cells compute. While Mischief 1 runs on standard computer chips, the startup aims to use these biological findings to increase AI efficiency, noting that the human brain operates on approximately 20 watts of power.
